analysis.title: Market Rhythm Focus
key_insights: US 10-year yields are testing trendline support after a 1-month slide. A decisive break below 4.86% flags a deeper reversal, which the desk labels negative for the AI trade. The 5% area and the 50dma remain the key resistance pivot, which the desk labels negative for breadth.
The 10-year yield shows a strong positive correlation with Semis (SOX) and a strong negative correlation with the S&P Equal Weighted index.

Philadelphia Semiconductors (SOX) is in a bear market per the desk: falling 50dma, a rejected old uptrend, the 200dma lost and July support broken, after the lowest close in over six months. Bear market counter-rallies can still be aggressive.

The S&P 500 Equal Weighted index is pushing higher, and its relative line versus the cap-weighted S&P has again broken its downtrend. If this holds, it would further confirm improving breadth and less mega-cap dominance.
The Transports ETF (IYT) jumped back above both its 50dma and 200dma in the prior session and closed at the 83 resistance. The newly regained moving averages need to hold to validate the turn.
Breadth, measured by NYSE stocks above their 200dma, is at seven-week highs while the Nasdaq hits correction territory and its 200dma. The desk notes the risk of a lower high still looms.
E-mini S&P 500 futures: 7,509 (the September low) is the key line in the sand. A decisive break opens 7,344/24, the 200dma and July low. A durable low needs upside momentum.
E-mini Nasdaq 100 futures are testing the 200dma into mid-terms and flirting with near-oversold conditions. A clean break below 28,076 targets 27,200.

Brent crude broke its steep uptrend from overbought levels and quickly tagged the rising 50dma and broader uptrend. Oscillators still need time to unwind. The negative correlation to Semis has paused.
Taiwan TAIEX closed below support at about 44,450, which puts the 200dma and then 40,000 in focus. RSI is nearing oversold, which may trigger a pause, but the overall tone remains negative.
India Nifty 50 has rebounded above its 50dma and is closer to its 200dma. Short-term overbought readings argue for a pause, but the setup looks increasingly constructive.
